note: Percentiles and buckets computed from the SERVED EPSG:4326 raster (the file goldbug zonal-samples), NOT the 25 m EPSG:3338 master. The 4326 reprojection resamples, so its distribution differs from the 3338 report (4326 max 0.655 vs 3338 max 0.855). Use these cutoffs for the legend/popup so the displayed buckets match the surface goldbug actually serves.

recommended_buckets.scheme: percentile-anchored, absolute cutoffs on the 0-1 probability
recommended_buckets.rationale: high>=p95 (top ~5% of onshore district ground), moderate>=p90, weak>=p75, floor below p75. The v3.1 0.5/0.3/0.1 absolute thresholds do NOT carry: at 0.5-high essentially the whole district renders below-weak (only ~0.6% of cells exceed 0.227).

coverage.guidance: Onshore cells with no placer signal score a real 0.0 (not nodata). Offshore / off-grid cells are -1.0 nodata. For the zonal-MAX consumer, set coverage_threshold: 0.0 so a parcel overlapping only nodata (-1.0) reports no-coverage rather than max=-1.0. A parcel that genuinely sits on low-probability onshore ground will correctly report a small positive max.
